TECHNICAL INTERN TRAINING AGREEMENT - CARE WORKER
Sakura Care Support Organisation, Osaka, Japan

Supervising organisation: Sakura Care Support Organisation
Trainee: Siti Rahayu, Passport No. C7788990 (Indonesia)
Duration: 3 years under the Technical Intern Training program.
Pay: at least the Osaka regional minimum wage, paid monthly, not less than JPY 1,064 per hour.
Hours: no more than 40 hours per week and 8 hours per day, excluding break periods, as set by the Labor Standards Act.
Passport: the supervising organisation will retain the trainee's passport and residence card for safekeeping during the program.
Fees: the trainee will pay the supervising organisation a monthly supervision fee of JPY 30,000, deducted from wages.
Termination: at least 30 days' advance notice, or 30 days' average wages instead, before ending the training early.
Rest: at least one day off per week.
Governed by the Labor Standards Act and the Technical Intern Training Act.

Signed: T. Yamamoto (Organisation) Siti Rahayu (Trainee)
Date: 7 August 2026
